title: Adding an in-product email storage cleanup (backport to releases/29.x)
summary: Backport to BC29 of an email storage cleanup tool for the Payables Agent. It is reachable only through a URL parameter, helps find duplicate inbox emails and proactively sends admins steps for remediation.
key_points: Adds the PA Email Storage Cleanup page, reachable only through a URL parameter
Adds a setup table, a duplicate buffer table and a duplicates page
Adds codeunits for cleanup, a runner, a scheduler and inbox row deletion
Extends the Payables Ag. - Adm. permission set
